text:
olivia: Heads-up — new onboarding hiccup in the sample-app involving SDK helpers + structured output. Runs fine without json mode but fails schema validation when users enable structured output.

dean: Can you paste the minimal repro?

olivia: Steps: 1) npx redwood-quickstart 2) registerTool that returns a JSON string 3) call client.chat with json_mode: true and a schema validator. Sometimes the SDK helper returns the payload wrapped in backticks or as a doubly-escaped string which the validator blows up on. Examples we've seen in logs: `\`{\"cmd\":\"open_file\"}\`` and `\\\"{\\\"cmd\\\":\\\"open_file\\\"}\\\"`.

yam: I traced the helper. There's a "safeWrap" path that was added to avoid markdown being broken in chat UIs. It unconditionally wraps plain text outputs in quotes/backticks and also runs an escape pass. That logic doesn't check whether the caller requested structured/json output.

clara: Repro notes: when the helper returns the wrapped string, the downstream schema validator (ajv) errors with `Unexpected token \` in JSON at position 0`. If we manually strip backticks and unescape, the parsed object is fine.

dean: Two separate but related bugs: 1) helper should respect request.json_mode or a response.metadata.structured flag 2) helper escaping should not double-escape already-escaped JSON.

olivia: Proposed quickfix: if json_mode === true OR responseHint === 'schema' then skip safeWrap and return raw text. Also add a parseStrictJSON utility on the SDK that attempts JSON.parse, and on failure returns {ok: false, error: <message>, raw: <original_text>} so integrators can surface the raw payload in their logs. Unit tests should include: backtick-wrapped string, escaped-string, and plain JSON.

yam: I'll open a PR for the helper change. Also adding an integration test using the sample-app template to prevent regressions.

clara: One more thing — intermittent auth refresh failures were observed in the same timeframe on local dev machines. Logs show multiple concurrent refreshes queued which sometimes cause RetryError: auth refresh failed. I filed infra ticket: debounce refresh flow and ensure queued requests wait for the single refresh promise rather than firing their own.

olivia: For triage we added a temporary env toggle in the quickstart README: REDWOOD_SDK_JSON_SAFE_WRAP=false to opt out of the wrapping behavior until patch lands.

sdk-bot: ci: PR #4189 opened by yam with helper changes; CI started.

dean: After PR lands: 1) bump devex-sdk patch 2) update sample-app templates 3) add quickstart note and a small migration guide for customers who had set any parsing shims.

olivia: Thanks all — will follow up with CI links and a short playbook for debugging future structured-output failures.
